body: **Foco:** Perfect participle passive — introdução.
**Pronúncia:** Expressividade.
**22 palavras novas** (comunicação intercultural).
**Texto do dia:** conto e trecho de peça.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar having been + particípio (Having been told…) para explicar uma causa ou sequência em uma cena.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

frames.title: Reading · A scene from a play

blocks.title: Scene: The Delegation
paras: The delegates sit around a long table. **Having been warned** about the delay, they are calm. **Not having been invited** to the first session, Mr. Reyes is annoyed.
REYES: **Having been left** out of the planning, I cannot approve the budget.
CHAIR: **Having been asked** twice to join, you declined. **Having been given** the agenda, you could have prepared.
REYES (quietly): **Having been treated** like a guest, not a partner, I am tired of waiting.

items.q: The delegates are calm because they were warned.
Mr. Reyes attended the first session.
The chair says Mr. Reyes was never asked to join.

head: Forma
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **Not having been invited**, he was annoyed.
**Having been left out**, I cannot approve it.

blocks.body: **Having been + particípio** indica ação passada que o sujeito **sofreu** e que explica o que vem depois. O sujeito da oração principal é o mesmo.
Não misture sujeitos: ✗ *Having been warned, the delay was short.* ✓ *Having been warned, we expected the delay.*

items.s: Not having been ___, he was annoyed. (invite)
Having been left ___ of the plan, I refused. (out)
Having been given the agenda, you ___ have prepared. (could)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Why is Reyes angry in this scene
items.pt: Por que Reyes está zangado nesta cena?

items.expt: The diplomatic row delayed the talks.
The walkout threat worried the chair.
The lift is out of order.

body: **Leave someone out in the cold.** — Deixar alguém de fora.
**Be kept in the dark.** — Ficar sem informação.
**Adjourn the session.** — Encerrar a sessão.
**Table a motion.** — Pôr uma proposta em pauta.
**Take the floor.** — Tomar a palavra.
**Walk out of the talks.** — Abandonar as negociações.
**Break the deadlock.** — Quebrar o impasse.
**Set the record straight.** — Esclarecer os fatos.
**Why is Reyes angry in this scene?** — Por que Reyes está zangado nesta cena?
**Having been left out of the planning, he feels disrespected.** — Tendo sido deixado de fora do planejamento, ele se sente desrespeitado.
**Say the line again, and lean on “left out”.** — Diga a fala de novo e enfatize “left out”.

items.label: Expressividade
items.note: Expressividade: varie altura, volume e velocidade para mostrar atitude; uma voz monótona soa desinteressada, mesmo com boas palavras.
words: That is NOT what I meant.

prompts.q: Explain why you could not attend something.
prompts.model: Not having been informed in time, I could not attend.

prompts.q: Say what you did after a warning.
prompts.model: Having been warned, I left early.
Having been ignored, he decided to speak.

blocks.task: Write a short scene of 6 lines with at least three perfect participle passives.
blocks.model: CHAIR: Having been informed of the problem, we must act. REYES: Not having been consulted, I object. CHAIR: Having been invited twice, you did not come. REYES: Having been given the wrong date, I could not. CHAIR: Then let us start again.
checklist: O sujeito é o mesmo na oração principal

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
